unitTitle: Organise work, study and future plans
title: Grammar: Futur simple: endings and common stems
subtitle: A2 · Unit 5: Organise work, study and future plans

steps.title: Add -ai, -as, -a, -ons, -ez, -ont. For an -re verb, drop the final e before adding the ending.
These common verbs use a special stem but keep the same six endings.
Futur simple: endings and common stems
steps.body:
• For most verbs, start with the infinitive and add -ai, -as, -a, -ons, -ez, -ont. With -re verbs, remove the last e: répondre → répondr-.
• Learn the common future stems together: être → ser-; avoir → aur-; aller → ir-; faire → fer-.
• A plan can use either form: je vais suivre un cours and je suivrai un cours are both possible. Near future is especially common in conversation; futur simple is common for schedules, written plans and predictions.
• In a basic future condition, keep present after si: si le groupe est complet, je choisirai un autre horaire. Do not say si le groupe sera complet.
• Make a six-person ladder in your notes for one regular verb, then retrieve one irregular stem without looking. Use your own real schedule in a new sentence.

steps.explain: With je, préparer takes the futur simple ending -ai: je préparerai.

steps.prompt: What is the futur simple form of être with je?
steps.explain: The irregular stem is ser- and the je ending is -ai: je serai.

steps.prompt: Choose the natural sentence: If the class is full, I will choose another time.
options: Si le cours est complet, je choisirai un autre horaire.
Si le cours sera complet, je choisirai un autre horaire.
Si le cours complet, choisirai horaire.
Si le cours est complet, je choisir un autre horaire.
steps.explain: Use present after si for this condition, then futur simple in the result: je choisirai.

steps.prompt: Which sentence has répondre in the futur simple with nous?
steps.explain: Drop final e from répondre, then add -ons: nous répondrons.
